participation.context: Looked at the shut stack and did not begin another.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You left the forty leaves as one book, and you did not open the coffer.

participation.context: Said the three sentences and did not continue.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said it was a feast with the guard set on it, that there was fire and nobody easy, and that it ought to have been the merriest night of the year, and you stopped.

title: Said it ought to have been the merriest night of the year
